Nigerian businessman Tony Elumelu has gifted singer Zlatan wedding presents, with the music star thanking him on social media. The gifts were wrapped in Heirs Holdings-branded packaging and featured handwritten inscriptions, including “Zlatan, well done”, “Our wife”, “Congrats” and “Zlatan”. The packages also bore Elumelu’s signature, with his initials, “TOE”, boldly written as the sender’s sign-off. Zlatan thanked the businessman on his Instagram story on Monday, tagging his handle and adding a love emoji. PUNCH Online had reported that the singer, whose real name is Omoniyi Raphael, released traditional wedding pictures with his partner, Davita Lamai, ahead of their traditional wedding ceremony. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources The music star shared the pictures on his official Instagram page with the caption, “IT’s TIME TO MARRY”. Celebrities, fans and well-wishers have since taken to the comments section to congratulate the couple. Influencer Enioluwa Adeoluwa wrote, “Love is a beautiful thing! Congratulations to the Omoniyi’s”. Comedian and skit maker Samuel Perry, popularly known as Broda Shaggi, also wrote, “Congratulations”. PUNCH Online earlier reported that the couple announced their wedding date in a video posted on October 8. Among those spotted at the ceremony were Seyi Vodi, Young John, Iyabo Ojo, Papaya Ex, Lil Kesh, Teni Makanaki and Ms DSF.
